pairs.en: In Al-Ahsa, craft is not an exhibit behind glass — it is a set of living trades handed down through families generation after generation
pairs.zh: 在哈萨，手工艺不是玻璃柜里的陈列，而是一门门活着的行当，由一个个家族世代相传

pairs.en: The Hasawi bisht is the cloak of ceremony and standing, and what sets it apart is the Hasawi weave: precise hand embroidery in zari threads coated with gold or silver water.
pairs.zh: 哈萨比什特长袍是身份与重大场合的礼袍，而它的独到之处在于哈萨织造：以镀金或镀银的扎里线手工绣成，针脚细密。

pairs.en: a pottery house where vessels are still shaped from clay in the old manual way and fired in its kilns
pairs.zh: 坊里的器皿至今仍用黏土手工塑成，再入窑烧制，做法一如从前

pairs.en: press coverage records that pottery has endured on this spot for more than six hundred years
pairs.zh: 媒体报道称，此地制陶已延续 600 多年

pairs.en: proof that in the oasis, the palm gives all of itself, from fruit to frond
pairs.zh: 足见在这片绿洲上，椰枣树浑身是宝，从果实到棕榈叶

pairs.en: It also holds a handicrafts academy run by experienced craftspeople who pass their trades to new generations
pairs.zh: 市集里还有一所传授手工艺的学院，由经验丰富的手工艺人主持，把手艺传给新一代

pairs.en: Yes — Dougha Al-Gharash, at the foot of Jabal Al-Qarah, is a visitor stop where you watch the stages of the craft from kneading the clay to the wheel to the kiln, and buy directly from its wares.
pairs.zh: 可以。加拉什家族的杜加陶坊就在卡拉山脚下，是游客游览的一站：从揉泥、陶轮拉坯到入窑烧制，制陶的各道工序都能看到，坊里的陶器也能直接选购。

pairs.en: The three stops fit together naturally
pairs.zh: 这三站正好连成一线

pairs.en: An honest gift from Al-Ahsa comes out of the oasis itself: from its palms, its citrus and the hands of its artisans.
pairs.zh: 哈萨最实在的礼物都出自绿洲本身：它的椰枣树、柑橘，以及手艺人的一双手。

pairs.en: Hasawi Lime and the Oasis Pantry
pairs.zh: 哈萨青柠与绿洲人家的常备

pairs.en: Khalas is the master variety — golden as fresh rutab in summer, amber as dried dates at season's end
pairs.zh: 哈拉斯（Khalas）是当家品种——夏天是金黄的软熟鲜椰枣（Rutab），季末则是琥珀色的全熟干果

pairs.en: From the same pantry come date syrup, which sweetens the local dishes, and date bread sprinkled with nigella seed.
pairs.zh: 同样是绿洲人家的常备，还有为本地菜增甜的椰枣糖浆，以及撒着黑种草籽的椰枣面包。

pairs.en: The Hasawi lime (Bin Zuhairi) is among the most celebrated produce of Al-Ahsa's groves
pairs.zh: 哈萨青柠（本地品种名 Bin Zuhairi）是哈萨果园里最有名的出产之一

pairs.en: Entry is free, and evening is its best hour.
pairs.zh: 免费入场，傍晚是它最好的时候。

pairs.en: And the cluster of adjoining souqs in Hofuf's heart
pairs.zh: 还有胡富夫市中心的那几座市集，彼此相邻，连成一片

pairs.en: The heritage souqs come alive in the evening
pairs.zh: 遗产市集要到傍晚才热闹起来

pairs.en: end the journey with a suitcase that carries the oasis home
pairs.zh: 为这趟旅程收个尾——让行李箱替您把绿洲带回家

pairs.en: A sea of palms with a mountain in it.
pairs.zh: 椰枣林如海，海中立着一座山

pairs.en: This is the green, slow, lived-in chapter of a Saudi journey
pairs.zh: 在一趟沙特之行里，这是绿的、慢的、有人过日子的那一章

pairs.en: a heritage that is still someone's daily life rather than a staged set
pairs.zh: 还有一份遗产——它至今仍是当地居民的日常生活，而不是为游客搭起的布景

pairs.en: If your idea of travel is ticking monuments off a list, Al-Ahsa will still fill two rewarding days.
pairs.zh: 如果您心目中的旅行是照着景点清单一处处打卡，哈萨也能给您两天不虚此行的日子。

pairs.en: water, palms and people have kept the same appointment for thousands of years
pairs.zh: 几千年来，水、椰枣树与人一直守着同一个约定

pairs.en: Al-Ahsa is the plural of hisy — sweet water gathered beneath a thin layer of sand, springing up where no one expects it
pairs.zh: “哈萨”（Al-Ahsa）是“希斯”（hisy）的复数——指薄薄一层沙土之下汇聚流淌的甘甜泉水，总在人们意想不到的地方涌出来

pairs.en: Water and wind shaped this rock over thousands of years, carving corridors so narrow the stone almost brushes your shoulders — then suddenly opening onto a high chamber pierced by a thread of light.
pairs.zh: 数千年来，水与风雕琢着山中的岩石，凿出一道道狭窄的石廊——两侧岩壁几乎触及肩头；转过一道弯，眼前豁然开朗，一线天光自石厅高处漏下。

pairs.en: step in at noon in August and an unexpected coolness greets you; step in on a winter night and it feels warm
pairs.zh: 八月正午走进去，迎面是一阵意想不到的清凉；冬夜走进去，留在身上的却是一层暖意

pairs.en: Nor is the mountain a single connected passage.
pairs.zh: 这座山并不是一条贯通到底的通道。

pairs.en: Al-Ahsa's heat rule is to keep open-air stops for morning and sunset, and the caves for the hours in between.
pairs.zh: 哈萨应对暑热的办法，就是把露天的景点留给清晨和日落，把洞穴留给中间的那几个钟头。

pairs.en: Some landmarks you visit to say you've seen them; Jabal Al-Qarah you visit to feel it
pairs.zh: 有些地标，您去是为了说一句“我看过了”。而卡拉山，您去是为了感受它

pairs.en: the corridor narrowing then the chamber opening
pairs.zh: 石廊先收紧，石厅再敞开

pairs.en: A small green fruit whose fragrance reaches you before you see it
pairs.zh: 这是一枚小小的绿色果子，人还没看见，香气就先到了

pairs.en: In this article: what sets the Hasawi lomi apart, when its season falls, how it fills the household pantry and flavours the local kitchen
pairs.zh: 本文要讲的是：哈萨青柠特别在哪里，时令落在什么时候，如何成为绿洲人家的常备，又如何为本地菜肴增香

pairs.en: From Tree to Pantry: Jameed, the Sun-Dried Lime
pairs.zh: 从树上到绿洲人家的常备：晒制青柠干“贾米德”

pairs.en: Lift the lid of a Hasawi pot and the lomi is there
pairs.zh: 揭开当地人家的锅盖，青柠总在里头

pairs.en: the heritage dish mufallaq is cracked wheat flavoured with lomi and crowned with dates and boiled eggs
pairs.zh: 传统菜式穆法拉格（Mufallaq）则是以青柠提味的碎麦，再缀上椰枣与水煮蛋

pairs.en: Dates are Al-Ahsa's headline; the lomi is its summer signature
pairs.zh: 椰枣是哈萨的招牌，青柠则是它夏天的落款

pairs.en: a small fruit that so distils the taste of the oasis it earned an exhibition of its own
pairs.zh: 小小一枚果子，把绿洲的味道浓缩得这样彻底，也就配得上一场属于自己的展会

pairs.en: The oasis needs no legend to be proud of its lime.
pairs.zh: 绿洲为自己的青柠感到自豪，并不需要一则传说。

pairs.en: Here begins the part where stories multiply and documents thin out, and honesty requires drawing its limits clearly.
pairs.zh: 从这里开始，说法多起来，文献却少下去；诚实的做法，是把界限划清楚。

pairs.en: The lomi's story is incomplete without its greatest danger.
pairs.zh: 不讲它最大的危险，青柠的故事就不完整。

pairs.en: The fruit's very name carries a trace of its journey.
pairs.zh: 这枚果子的名字本身就留着旅途的痕迹。

pairs.en: The significance runs deeper than it looks
pairs.zh: 这条线索的分量比看上去更重

pairs.en: which traced the spread of 17 food crops, the acid lime and the sour orange among them
pairs.zh: 他追溯了 17 种食用作物的传播，来檬与酸橙就在其中

pairs.en: a complete food culture crowned by the custom of jameed
pairs.zh: 还有一整套饮食文化，而这套文化的顶点，正是“贾米德”（jameed）的习俗

pairs.en: No historical document dates its arrival in Al-Ahsa specifically.
pairs.zh: 没有哪份历史文献为它传入哈萨一事定下过年代。

pairs.en: the best available account concerns the immediate neighbourhood, not Al-Ahsa itself
pairs.zh: 现有最可靠的一条说法讲的是紧邻的地区，而不是哈萨本身

pairs.en: Every lomi tree in Al-Ahsa is therefore, by necessity, descended from a tree that arrived from outside.
pairs.zh: 所以哈萨的每一棵青柠树，必然都是从外面来的某棵树的后代。

pairs.en: India was a corridor and a centre of dispersal, not the first homeland.
pairs.zh: 印度是通道，是扩散的中心，却不是最初的家园。

pairs.en: Something worth more than a claim of origin
pairs.zh: 剩下的东西比“原产地”这个名头更可贵

pairs.en: a landrace of low genetic diversity in a region facing a disease that has destroyed a million trees next door
pairs.zh: 一个遗传多样性偏低的地方品种，身处一个正面临病害的地区——而这种病害已经在紧邻的地方毁掉了百万棵树

pairs.en: Anything not stated in the article as settled is open to revision when a new peer-reviewed study appears.
pairs.zh: 凡本文未以定论口吻陈述的内容，都可能因新的同行评议研究而修订。

pairs.en: The fruit that came from afar is today the emblem of the oasis summer.
pairs.zh: 这枚从远方来的果子，如今成了绿洲夏天的象征。
